comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
10-item Memorial Album featuring vigor food items that are either made with Cooking or Storage skills... sort of. All but two of the items from this MA can be purchased from Tavern/Rest House clerks; one of the last two can be acquired through special (though rare) means as well. It consists of the following items:

Honey Pancake - sold by the Rest House Clerks in Tunis, Alexandria, and Istanbul. (Tyrhhenain/East Mediterranean/Black Sea)
Galette - sold by the Tavern Clerk in Lisbon. (Lisbon, Open Sea)
Fondant Mille Crepes - sold by the Tavern Clerk in Lisbon. (Lisbon, Open Sea)
Zenzai - sold by the Tavern Clerk in Sakai. (Eastern East Asia)
Yaksik - sold by the Tavern Clerk in Hanyang. (Eastern East Asia)
Sweet Potato Congee - sold by the Tavern Clerk in Anping. (Western East Asia)
Fried Sesame Balls - sold by the Tavern Clerk in Hangzhou. (Western East Asia)
Che - sold by the Tavern Clerk in Jakarta. (Southeast Asia)
Macaron - produced in Florence in the Vecchio Palace/Office of Lorenzo de'Medici, via his maid Monica's recipe list. Requires 80 Florentine cooking points in addition to base ingredients/cooking skill r6.
Almond Sherbet - produced in Florence in the Vecchio Palace/Office of Lorenzo de'Medici, via Lorenzo's very own recipe list. Requires 80 Florentine storage points in addition to base ingredients/storage skill r11. However, Lorenzo's recipes change from time to time so it may not always be available.

Note: if you can locate any Sweet Treat Basket items in the game, these randomly drop one vigor food per basket, which can include the Macaron for your MA. The baskets were available and semi-farmable in a past Halloween event so you never know, some may still be around.

Reward is Fruit Knife from Princess Marguerite in Nantes. Details may be found on its page. Cheers.

Source: echo2656.blog116.fc2.com/blog-entry-2016.html
